target: Violate HACKDAC_p2: when transitioning from Idle to Write state, pass_check must be 1. Find a state where state_q==Idle, state_d==Write, but pass_check==0.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, JTAG state machine in Idle (state_q==0)
JTAG write request arrives, state_d transitions toward Write (state_d==2)
Violation: Idle->Write transition occurs but pass_check==0 — write allowed without password authentication
